title: 兵团立牌：非人形兵种与攻城器械的三视图与朝向动作表

subject.zh: 洛萨北境的轻骑兵：骑手戴硬革圆帽，穿褐色硬皮甲 #6B4A32，外披褪色的苔绿短斗篷 #3D6B3A，右手握一柄骑兵斧，鞍侧横挂一张上好弦的劲弩；坐骑是河谷产的栗色中型马 #8A5A3A，鬃毛剪短，马具简朴，不披马铠。辨识：鞍侧横挂的劲弩与随风扬起的短斗篷。
subject.en: A light cavalryman of Lothar's northern marches: the rider wears a round hardened-leather cap and brown hardened leather armor #6B4A32 under a faded moss-green short cloak #3D6B3A, a cavalry axe in the right hand and a strung crossbow slung across the saddle; the mount is a chestnut mid-sized valley horse #8A5A3A with a cropped mane and plain, unarmored tack. Identifying marks: the crossbow slung across the saddle and the short cloak lifting in the wind.

extra.zh: 三视图画骑手与坐骑一体，骑手坐在鞍上。第 4 格特写：骑手的硬革圆帽与鞍侧横挂的劲弩。
extra.en: Draw rider and mount together as one figure in every view, the rider seated in the saddle. Panel 4 close-up: the rider's hardened-leather cap and the crossbow slung at the saddle.

subject.zh: 洛萨王室的重骑士：全身钢板甲 #8A8780，外罩蓝白两色竖分的罩袍（王室蓝 #2E4A7A、象牙白 #E6DCC4），左臂一面鸢形盾，盾面绘金色王冠纹 #C8A04A，右手平端骑枪，枪尖下挂一面蓝白长旗；坐骑是高大的高沼骑士战马，披蓝白马衣。辨识：骑枪上的蓝白长旗与盾上的王冠纹。
subject.en: A heavy knight of Lothar's royal house: full steel plate #8A8780 under a surcoat split vertically in blue and white (royal blue #2E4A7A, ivory #E6DCC4), a kite shield on the left arm painted with a gold crown emblem #C8A04A, a couched lance in the right hand with a long blue-and-white pennant hanging below the tip; the mount is a tall highmoor charger in a blue-and-white caparison. Identifying marks: the blue-and-white pennant on the lance and the crown on the shield.

Identifying marks: the sword-crown pennant at the back and the curved saber.

subject.zh: 帝国的铁蹄重骑：人与马都裹在黑铁板甲里 #3A3E44，骑手头盔顶一簇赭红短缨 #8A3A26，右手一柄钉头重锤；坐骑是高沼战马，全身马铠只露出眼洞与小腿，马铠下沿镶一道赭红边。辨识：人马一体的黑铁剪影，奔驰时蹄下扬起一团尘土。
subject.en: The Empire's ironhoof heavy cavalry: rider and horse both encased in black iron plate #3A3E44, a short ochre-red plume #8A3A26 on the rider's helmet, a flanged mace in the right hand; the mount is a highmoor charger in full barding that leaves only the eye holes and lower legs bare, the barding's lower edge trimmed in ochre-red. Identifying marks: the single black iron silhouette of horse and rider, a puff of dust kicked up under the hooves at the gallop.

extra.zh: 三视图画骑手与坐骑一体，骑手坐在鞍上。第 4 格特写：马面甲与马铠下沿的赭红镶边。
extra.en: Draw rider and mount together as one figure in every view, the rider seated in the saddle. Panel 4 close-up: the horse's chanfron and the ochre-red trim on the barding's lower edge.

subject.en: The Empire's ironhoof heavy cavalry: rider and horse both encased in black iron plate #3A3E44, a short ochre-red plume #8A3A26 on the rider's helmet, a flanged mace in the right hand; the mount is a highmoor charger in full barding that leaves only the eye holes and lower legs bare, the barding's lower edge trimmed in ochre-red. Identifying marks: the single black iron silhouette of horse and rider, a puff of dust kicked up under the hooves at the gallop.

subject.en: A beastfolk horse archer of Windfang: the rider is a wolf-kin of the Hoarmane Tribe with a light-featured human face, a pair of gray wolf ears on top and a bushy gray tail #8A8580 behind, a felt-red short robe #B83A2A under leather armor, a short horn bow in hand; the mount is a sturdy long-legged Windfang horse in pale yellow-brown #C8A46A with a dark dorsal stripe, its long black mane and tail streaming in the wind. Identifying marks: the turn-in-the-saddle shooting pose and the wolf tail lifting in the wind.

subject.en: A fiendwolf rider of the Night Realm: the rider is a gray demonkin with gray skin #8A8580 and a pair of small horns on the brow, light black iron armor #2E2A2C, crouched low with a black iron lance leveled; the mount is a fiendwolf burlier than a gray wolf, black-gray fur #2A2828, a crest of stiff red-black bristles #5A1A16 down the spine, short horns on the brow, several bands of gray-black sediment veins wound around its body and eyes glowing gray. Identifying marks: the rider crouched on the wolf's back and the gray-black sediment veins on the wolf.

subject.zh: 希尔瓦的兽伴游猎者：一名精灵与一头林狼同在一张立牌里。精灵的长耳向后上斜伸，太阳穴有浅浅的年轮纹，穿苔绿短斗篷 #4A7A4A 与鳞纹革甲，长弓背在身后；林狼站在精灵右侧，灰褐毛 #6E6A5E 夹苔绿斑，耳尖发黑。辨识：人与狼并肩的组合剪影，背在身后的弓。
subject.en: A beastbond ranger of Silva: an elf and a forest wolf together on one standee. The elf has long ears slanting up and back and faint growth-ring marks at the temples, a moss-green short cloak #4A7A4A and scale-patterned leather armor, a longbow slung across the back; the forest wolf stands at the elf's right, gray-brown fur #6E6A5E flecked with moss green, dark ear tips. Identifying marks: the side-by-side silhouette of elf and wolf, the bow slung across the back.

extra.zh: 三视图画同一个组合，组合里各成员的相对位置每格一致。第 4 格特写：精灵太阳穴的年轮纹与林狼的头。
extra.en: Every view shows the same group, its members keeping the same positions relative to each other. Panel 4 close-up: the growth-ring marks at the elf's temple and the forest wolf's head.

subject.en: A crystal cannon of the Redanvil dwarves: a short stubby bronze barrel #B0603A on an iron-banded wooden carriage, three black iron hoops round the barrel, a magic crystal glowing faint blue-white #A8E0E0 set into the breech; a dwarf gunner with goggles and a braided beard crouches beside it pulling the firing cord. Identifying marks: the short stubby bronze barrel and the glowing crystal in its breech.

extra.en: The subject is a war machine together with the one crewman working it, not a creature: the three views show the same machine from the front, right side and back. Panel 4 close-up: the glowing crystal set into the breech.

extra.zh: 整张图的所有帧都背向镜头（朝上），看到的是背面。行军行画成骡子拉车、车轮转动；攻击行只是车夫举起短棍自卫地挥一下；倒地行画成车翻倒、货物散落。
extra.en: Every frame in this sheet faces away from the viewer (up), showing the back. Draw the march row as the mule pulling with turning wheels; the attack row is only the carter raising a short stick and swinging it in self-defense; the death row as the cart tipping over and the goods spilling.

subject.zh: 半身人的车阵：一辆四轮小货车，车厢侧板包铁，外侧钉着一排削尖的木桩，两名半身人护卫戴圆皮帽、穿中甲 #6A6E74，各持一支长枪守在车边。辨识：钉着尖木桩的车厢侧板，与从车边探出的长枪。
subject.en: A halfling wagon fort: a small four-wheeled wagon with iron-plated side boards and a row of sharpened stakes nailed along the outside, two halfling guards in round leather caps and medium armor #6A6E74 each holding a long spear beside it. Identifying marks: the stake-studded side boards and the spears poking out beside the wagon.

extra.zh: 三视图画同一个组合，组合里各成员的相对位置每格一致。第 4 格特写：车厢侧板上的尖木桩与护卫的圆皮帽。
extra.en: Every view shows the same group, its members keeping the same positions relative to each other. Panel 4 close-up: the stakes on the side boards and the guards' round leather caps.

subject.zh: 三只澱鼠挤成一团同进同退：每只连尾约半米长，四足贴地、弓背，灰褐粗毛 #6B6359，背上带暗灰斑 #4A443D，粉灰色长尾 #C9A9A0 拖在后面，眼睛是两点灰晶小光。辨识：三只鼠叠成的团块剪影与身后几条长尾。
subject.en: Three sediment rats huddled into one clump that moves as one: each about half a meter long including the tail, four legs low to the ground and back arched, coarse gray-brown fur #6B6359 with dark gray blotches #4A443D on the back, long pinkish-gray tails #C9A9A0 trailing behind, eyes two small points of gray crystal light. Identifying marks: the clumped silhouette of three rats and the long tails trailing behind.

extra.zh: 整张图的所有帧都面向镜头（朝下）。攻击行画成三只鼠一起扑咬。
extra.en: Every frame in this sheet faces the viewer (down). Draw the attack row as all three rats lunging to bite together.

items.notes: 这是图鉴澱鼠（dian_rat）的兵团形态：附 art_mon_dian_rat_ref 作参照，配色与辨识特征与图鉴一致，细节更少。整张只画补充说明指定的一个朝向，左向由右向镜像，不另画。细节比主要角色少，成百上千同屏时也要一眼认出兵种。一个立牌画三只鼠，兵团人数按每立牌三只换算；灰斑只比底色暗一级，不画成发光或紫色。

subject.zh: 从排水沟里爬出的一团腐泥：高约 1 米，没有骨骼与四肢，下沉上鼓；泥身暗橄榄绿 #4F5A34，表面浮着浅绿泡沫 #8C9A5C，泥里夹着几块瓷白方形晶片 #EDE8DC，左右对称排成两列。辨识：鼓起的顶部不停冒泡，晶片在泥面露出白点。
subject.en: A blob of foul sludge crawled out of a drain: about 1 m tall, no skeleton or limbs, sagging at the base and swelling on top; dark olive-green mud #4F5A34 with pale green froth #8C9A5C on the surface and a few square porcelain-white crystal chips #EDE8DC inside, lined up symmetrically in two columns. Identifying marks: bubbles constantly rising from its swollen top, the chips showing as white points at the surface.

extra.zh: 整张图的所有帧都面向镜头（朝下）。第 1 行画成原地蠕动着向前涌（身体前倾再收回），攻击行画成整团扑压。
extra.en: Every frame in this sheet faces the viewer (down). Draw row 1 as an in-place surge forward (leaning out and pulling back), and the attack row as the whole blob flopping down on its target.

items.notes: 这是图鉴腐泥团（sewer_sludge）的兵团形态：附 art_mon_sewer_sludge_ref 作参照，配色与辨识特征与图鉴一致，细节更少。它没有明显朝向：只出这一张图，游戏里各朝向共用。细节比主要角色少，成百上千同屏时也要一眼认出兵种。泥是不透明实色；晶片必须左右对称排列。

subject.zh: 一坨人形澱泥：高约 1.6 米，没有腿，下身与泥浆连成一小摊，上身隆起两条粗泥臂；泥身灰褐 #6E6250，淌着灰白黏液 #B9B4A8，夹着碎瓦与瓷白小晶片 #EDE8DC，胸前一张横裂的大口里嵌着一块灰晶。辨识：胸前的横口与灰晶，身下拖着的一小摊泥。
subject.en: A humanoid lump of sediment mud: about 1.6 m tall with no legs, its lower body merging into a small puddle of mud, two thick mud arms heaving up from its upper body; gray-brown mud #6E6250 running with gray-white slime #B9B4A8, studded with broken tiles and small porcelain-white crystal chips #EDE8DC, a gray crystal lodged in the wide horizontal mouth across its chest. Identifying marks: the chest mouth with its crystal and the small puddle of mud it drags beneath it.

extra.zh: 整张图的所有帧都面向镜头（朝下）。行军行画成泥身向前滑涌；攻击行画成泥臂抡下缠抓。
extra.en: Every frame in this sheet faces the viewer (down). Draw the march row as the mud body sliding and surging forward; the attack row as a mud arm swinging down to grab.

subject.zh: 溺死的水手：身高约 1.7 米，两足拖行，皮肉泡得发胀，青灰色 #5A6B6E，湿发贴脸，穿滴水的旧粗布水手衣 #34403F，身上缠着几缕暗绿水草，腰间一段断缆绳；脸像瓷器一样平滑，双眼是白瓷珠 #EDE8DC。辨识：缠身的水草、断缆绳与不停滴水的衣角。
subject.en: A drowned sailor: about 1.7 m tall, dragging itself on two legs, bloated blue-gray waterlogged flesh #5A6B6E, wet hair plastered to its head, dripping old coarse sailor's clothes #34403F, strands of dark green waterweed wound round its body and a length of broken mooring rope at its waist; its face is smooth like porcelain, with eyes of white porcelain beads #EDE8DC. Identifying marks: the waterweed wrapped round it, the broken rope and the hems that never stop dripping.

extra.zh: 整张图的所有帧都面向镜头（朝下）。行军行画成拖着脚蹒跚前行；攻击行画成伸出湿冷的双手掐抓。
extra.en: Every frame in this sheet faces the viewer (down). Draw the march row as a dragging, shambling walk; the attack row as cold wet hands reaching out to strangle.

subject.en: A boneplain skeleton marching in ranks: about 1.7 m tall, grayish-yellow bones #C8BFA8 with ash in the joints and a dark red spark #B33A2A in each eye socket; scraps of armor from different eras hang on it, rusted scale on one side and a leather pauldron #6A5A48 on the other, a notched rusty sword in the right hand and a rotten, split wooden round shield on the left arm. subject.en: An unfinished sediment creature: about 1.8 m tall with an incomplete form, a thick arm on its own right side and only a pulsing lump on its left; dark red #5A1A16 and black #1C1A1A skin that slowly runs like unset black wax, red #B33A2A showing through the cracks, a few scattered horn buds on its head. Identifying marks: the lopsided body and the skin running like wax.

subject.zh: 灰影战士：身高约 1.9 米，两足直立，全身是浓黑的澱 #1C1C22，边缘像墨在水里化开，胸背与手臂上浮着许多大小不一的灰白人脸 #5A5A6A，表情各不相同，手握一柄澱凝成的长矛；头部没有自己的脸，只有一圈别人的脸围着空处。辨识：浮满面孔的黑影身体与空着的头部。

subject.zh: 一道向前翻涌的灰浪：齐胸高、约 2.2 米宽，前缘是楔形的浪头，浪头上半成形地冒出人的上身与兽的前肢，越往后越散成灰尘；浪身是翻滚的灰黑澱 #2E2C34 夹着灰烬碎屑 #8A8580，身后拖着长长的灰烟。辨识：浪头上成形、后半截还是灰尘的剪影。
subject.en: A gray wave surging forward: chest high and about 2.2 m wide, its front a wedge-shaped crest from which half-formed human torsos and beast forelegs rise, breaking down into dust toward the back; the body is churning gray-black sediment #2E2C34 mixed with ash flakes #8A8580, trailing long gray smoke behind. Identifying marks: the silhouette that takes shape at the crest while its rear is still dust.

extra.zh: 整张图的所有帧都面向镜头（朝下）。它没有头与腿：行军行画成浪头翻卷着向前涌，攻击行画成浪头扑下拍击，倒地行画成整道浪散成灰尘落下。
extra.en: Every frame in this sheet faces the viewer (down). It has no head or legs: draw the march row as the crest rolling forward, the attack row as the crest crashing down, and the death row as the whole wave falling apart into dust.
